user.strategy_description: Fade teams on 4+ win streak vs market (variation)
user.strategy_long_explanation: Uses win streak, KXNFLGAME. Entry team 4+ win streak, moneyline >0.70, bet NO. Position 1%. Why work: market overvalues streak, regression. Why fail: good teams keep winning. Evidence: 4+ streak teams win next 58% vs 70% implied (fade profitable).
